name: Durlangen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and red, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Durlangen (a green fir on white).
history: Arms and flag were granted to the municipality on 19 September 1957; the colours white and red are taken from the arms of the former imperial city of Schwäbisch Gmünd.

features.role: Durlangen arms — green fir on white
